messages:
Maya (People Ops): Sharing a compact manager kit for the upcoming review cycle: 5-min prep, 3-bullet self-review prompt, and a tiny 3-tier rubric. Copy/paste friendly.

Ravi (Eng Manager): Love this. Can we make the rubric very short so scoring is quick?

Maya (People Ops): Yep 0 chars per line. Here it is.

reminder-bot: Note: review period opens in 4 days - see /perf for details.

Maya (People Ops): [MANAGER KIT]
- 5-min prep: read self-review (3 bullets), scan last goal, jot 1-sentence rationale.
- Self-review prompt to ICs: paste 3 bullets: 1) top contribution, 2) key learning, 3) one ask from manager. Keep each <=140 chars.
- 3-tier rubric (one-line each):
  * Exceeds: Regularly goes beyond expected impact; clear examples. Tip: name behaviors to repeat.
  * Meets: Consistently delivers expected outcomes. Tip: acknowledge & set a single stretch.
  * Needs Growth: Outcomes inconsistent; show gaps. Tip: agree one concrete next step + timeline.
- Manager rationale template: "Rating: [Tier]. Evidence: [one example]. Next: [action + owner + due]."

Jo (SWE): Super useful. Can People Ops add character limits to the form to avoid long essays?

Ben (People Ops Lead): Yes - we'll enforce 140-char fields and drop this into the manager playbook. Thanks Maya!

Maya (People Ops): Done 00 char doc will go in the kickoff and I'll ping again in the weekly. Feel free to DM edits. :thumbsup:
